productConnection: A tiny paper-moth archivist whose open-book wings gather scattered sources and whose bookmark ribbon carries them into a connected brief.
silhouette: One round indigo body with stubby limbs and two broad ivory wings shaped like open book pages; the wing span is about 1.6 times the body width.
proportions: The round body is one head-and-body mass, the open-book wing span is 1.6 times the body width, limbs stay stubby, and both antennae remain shorter than one wing page.
faceRule: Two small black oval eyes, one tiny curved mouth, and two coral cheek dots on the upper half of the round body.
signatureFeature: Two coral-tipped antennae and one lime bookmark ribbon visible behind the lower body in every pose.
appealHook: The open-book wings make every greeting feel like a tiny research note unfolding for the user.
renderingRule: Premium tactile 3D cut-paper craft on a warm ivory background, with visible paper fibres, folded wing creases, layered cobalt edges, soft editorial light, and restrained shadows.
clearSpace: Keep clear space equal to half the round body width around the full wings, antennae, and bookmark ribbon.
avoids: No plush, clay, glossy plastic, or photoreal insect rendering.
